name: Logo & Favicon Studio
description: A powerful, intuitive Logo and Favicon creator supporting smart auto-trimming of white borders, interactive rectangle cropping, multi-format exports (SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, ICO), universal image resizing, Social Media Kit (1:1 profile avatars & 16:9 banners), automatic multi-size favicon package generation (16px to 512px), Google Play Feature Graphic (1024x500), customizable templates, live realistic mockups, and auto-save.
